intro_same: Practice: the same Garnet ransomware night, with fewer hints and harder questions. Most answers need you to follow one fact from a log into another file.

ask: At what UTC time (HH:MM) was the memory image of eng-ws14 taken?
How many minutes after the helpdesk ticket was the incident team called?
On which date did the tape backup you can restore from run? (YYYY-MM-DD)
How many hours does the restore from tape take?
How many files does the audit count say were renamed?
From which outside IP address did the s.kale VPN login come?
Which file did the attacker download from that same address? (file name)
Which program read the lsass dump? (file name)
What are the last 8 characters of the hash px.exe passed?
What is the parent PID of lsass.exe?
Which local port did px.exe use for its connection to fs02?
How many seconds after the network logon was the WinUpdSvc service installed?
Which program turned off boot recovery? (file name)
Which ATT&CK technique ID is the LSASS memory dump? (with the sub-technique)
